comments.body:
Thank you for the feature request,  it’s a very reasonable suggestion. 
While I’m advocating for this internally, I can't comment directly on the NuRec roadmap as it is managed by a separate core team and serves a much broader customer base than just AlpaSim. 

To ensure we get you the most accurate technical answer, I’ve reached out to their product experts to see how this fits into their wider implementation standards. I’ll follow up with you as soon as I have their input.

I'm going to close this ticket for now.
